title: Many vehicles are forced to wait longer than usual time after green light appears.
situation: Many vehicles are forced to wait longer than usual time after green light appears.
description: A vehicle maybe required by traffic signal to free up space for priority vehicles or overtaking vehicles or to de-congest further routes, adding to waiting time of the vehicle all throughout its route.

Yes,priorityvehiclesaretobeletmovingandvehicleswhicharesloweddownneedstobecompensated for. 3. Is it theoretical? source_proposed_solutions: 1. Vehicle tells traffic signals on arrival that it has waited fairly long to reach the place. 2. Traffic signal network tries to keep the vehicle’s movement as smooth as possible. 3. Traffic signal tries to update the route to shorten inconvenience.
